context:
Goal: every step you ruled on gets worked, not left as a line in a report (your 13:39 CST ruling).
Problem (goal): about 70 steps you ruled on have no one working them, but your Nov 10 hold still allows only fixes to things already on main, and the new work waits until the merges in flight finish.
Based on (read): the roadmap at 1df0030a9 holds about 70 unblocked steps with your rulings and no worker.
Based on (ruling): your hold of 09:18 CST Nov 10 (no new work except fixes to things on main), and your Nov 10 ruling that new work starts after the merges in flight finish.
Departs from: main, where ruled steps wait as report lines until new work opens — the coordinator starts them itself.
Meanwhile: triage sorts the 70 into fixes and new work; the coordinator starts the fixes as soon as the list is ready, whichever option you pick.
home: roadmap step ruled-step-coordinator-queue (a ruled step with no worker is the coordinator's to start)
